body_markdown:
Aug 28, 2026


- [News Release](https://global.honda/en/newsroom/)


# Production, Sales and Export Results for July, 2026


-
-


Honda Motor Co., Ltd. today announced a summary of automobile production, Japan domestic sales, and export results for the month of July 2026.


#### World Production


July 2026 YOY July 2025


Japan 68,450 units 101.0% 67,804 units


Outside of Japan 200,070 units 95.3% 209,833 units


Total 268,520 units 96.7% 277,637 units


#### Production in Main Regions


North America 141,166 units 119.0% 118,601 units


USA 88,911 units 132.0% 67,336 units


Asia 50,125 units 58.9% 85,041 units


China 13,932 units 24.9% 55,941 units


##### July 2026


- Production in Japan: 8th consecutive month of YOY increase
- Production outside Japan: 7th consecutive month of YOY decrease
- Worldwide production: 6th consecutive month of YOY decrease


#### Sales in the Japanese Market


July 2026 YOY July 2025


Total 61,799 units 117.9% 52,438 units


Registrations 34,134 units 115.5% 29,561 units


Mini-vehicles 27,665 units 120.9% 22,877 units


##### July 2026


- Total sales in Japan: 4th consecutive month of YOY increase
- New vehicle registrations: 4th consecutive month of YOY increase
- Sales of mini-vehicles: 3rd consecutive month of YOY increase


#### Exports from Japan


July 2026 YOY July 2025


Total 8,589 units 91.8% 9,358 units


North America 946 units 72.5% 1,304 units


USA 846 units 64.9% 1,304 units


Asia 371 units 72.9% 509 units


Europe 5,390 units 148.1% 3,640 units


Others 1,882 units 48.2% 3,905 units


##### July 2026


- Total exports from Japan: 3rd consecutive month of YOY decrease
